0583.name: ResetCoolantInit

084E.name: FlexLearnLimitV006B2

0866.name: CrankEthanolScale

0A12.name: WotMapScale

0932.desc: Deceleration enleanment: time since start to row position of DecelLeanTimeCoolant

0B18.name: CrankV0769DecayWeight

1581.name: WarmupMapCoolant
